infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aura uses the camera to take photos for your stories and chat messages. A photo is only sent when you choose to share it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aura lets you choose an existing photo for your profile picture, a story, or a chat message. Only the photo you pick is shared — Aura never reads your library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Only while you are sharing your location, Aura keeps your position current in the background so people nearby see where you are and you are told when someone is close. It stops the moment you choose Paused or close Aura. This is optional — sharing works while the app is open without it.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Only while you are sharing your location, Aura keeps your position current in the background so people nearby see where you are and you are told when someone is close. It stops the moment you choose Paused or close Aura. This is optional — sharing works while the app is open without it.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Aura uses your location to show you people nearby who share your interests. Sharing starts Paused every time you open Aura: while it is Paused your location answers only your own searches and is never saved or shown to anyone. You are shown to other people only after you choose Live or Approximate yourself, on a screen explaining what that means, and it ends when you choose Paused or close Aura.
